newsitem.title: CHINA: China urges Taiwan to act to improve relations.
newsitem.headline: China urges Taiwan to act to improve relations.

text.p: China on Thursday declined to comment on a U.S. call not to hold military exercises on the eve of Hong Kong's handover to Beijing and urged rival Taiwan to take more actions conducive to improving relations.

Asked whether China planned to hold military exercises in the weeks before the handover of Hong Kong on July 1, at the same time as planned Taiwan war games, Foreign Ministry spokesman Cui Tiankai declined to comment.
He avoided a direct comment on Taiwan's military exercises planned for June 23-24, but urged the island that it considers a rebel province to boost strained ties between the two arch-rivals.
"We hope the Taiwan authorities will take more actions that are conducive to improving relations between the two sides," he told a regular news briefing.
He also avoided comment on a U.S. call to both sides not to go ahead with any planned exercises.
